correctness.rationale: Theorem reg(S/I(L_n))=ceil(n/2)=nu(L_n) verified. Lower bound: odd rungs are induced (distance >=2 along rails) giving nu>=ceil(n/2); Katzman nu<=reg gives reg lower bound; odd-rung sphere argument gives char-independent extremal homology. Upper bound nu<=ceil(n/2) holds via interval-gap argument (each edge covers 1-2 columns, induced edges need >=1 column gap, so k edges need >=2k-1 columns); DRAFT block wording is imprecise (says at most one attached rail edge) but fixable and statement true. Deletion isomorphisms L_n-x=M_{n-1}, L_n-N[x]=M_{n-2} and M_m analogues verified by inspection and machine iso_checks 12/12 for n=3,4,5; general case is index shift. Vertex bound reg(G)<=max(reg(G-x),reg(G-N[x])+1) is standard Ha-Van Tuyl/Dao-Huneke-Schweig/Woodroofe form. Joint induction from bases n<=6 gives ceil arithmetic max(ceil((t-1)/2),ceil((t-2)/2)+1)=ceil(t/2). Hochster computation re-executed independently for L_n,M_n n=1..5 (p=2,7919) and L_5,L_6 (p=2) matching table 1,1,2,2,3,3; code logic reviewed (neighbor masks, independent-set enumeration, mod-p Gauss-Jordan, R0=1 augmented) and extremal sphere homology dim 1 confirmed. Three-prime agreement plus combinatorial upper bound and Z-sphere lower bound justify characteristic-independence claim.

originality.rationale: Live arXiv API searches performed: regularity+edge-ideal+ladder (0 hits), induced-matching+ladder (0), edge-ideal+grid (1 irrelevant connected-ideal/co-grid paper 2512.06346), regularity+prism+edge (11 hits: only perfect matchings/Turan/matroid/metric, no edge-ideal regularity), ladder+regularity (only determinantal ladders 2202.03995/2305.18167, physics ladders, RKHS ladders - different ideals/meanings). Nearest cited priors substantively distinct: 2308.06010 fan graphs are clique-joins F_k^W(K_n)/circ/* gluings, disjoint from subcubic Cartesian P_n box K2 with only 4-cycles; 2405.06781 gives bipartite induced/ordered-matching inequalities and power regularity for indm=ordm class, no ladder equality (L_2=C4 has indm=1<ordm); 0807.2185 is the splitting method with no ladder/grid formula. Determinantal ladder varieties concern minors, not squarefree edge ideals. No prior states or implies reg=nu=ceil(n/2) for open ladders.

value.rationale: Exact closed-form reg=nu for the smallest subcubic 4-cycle-rich bipartite family outside forests/chordal/co-chordal/published fan/down-left families. Gives clean test case for splitting/Hochster induction, template for prisms/Mobius, with closed-form spherical extremal witnesses valid for all n and characteristic-independent proof. Not a textbook restatement (requires joint pendant-ladder closure), not parameter substitution (new graph family), not tiny gain (infinite-family equality), not unexplained enumeration (computation only for n<=6 bases + induction). Independently worth finding later as citable base case.
